rubric.benchmark: Evidence-based internal implementation-readiness assessment, not an external benchmark.

dimensions.label: Conversion clarity
dimensions.afterRationale: The source and focused-plugin READMEs now open with a concrete product outcome, current app proof, equal Claude/ChatGPT/Codex paths, direct model and pricing destinations, and a complete contributor route; contract tests preserve that two-level commercial and technical journey.
dimensions.remainingGap: The refreshed focused README still needs to be synchronized to the public plugin repository, and no clean acquisition cohort or observed first-screen conversion evidence identifies which path converts qualified visitors.

dimensions.label: Editorial personality
dimensions.afterRationale: The voice contract and both rewritten READMEs now lead with producer outcomes, use short direct answers and concrete prompts, and keep a restrained friendly personality without removing the engineering depth expected on GitHub.
dimensions.remainingGap: No external support or user-language review has yet tested whether the voice remains equally clear outside the authored repository surfaces.

dimensions.label: Visual proof and rhythm
dimensions.afterRationale: Six fresh, privacy-safe production captures now create a non-repeating app-to-examples-to-scoreboard-to-models-to-pricing-to-assistant sequence, with Library continuity as a separate seventh proof. The asset contract verifies unique bytes, dimensions, provenance, placement, decode integrity, and release inclusion.
dimensions.remainingGap: The public plugin repository still needs the refreshed bundle, and no independently archived native-host result packet exists for a host-specific visual claim.

dimensions.label: GitHub SEO
dimensions.afterRationale: Question-led headings, direct product definitions, descriptive image alternatives, current model/comparison/pricing vocabulary, canonical product links, technical stack coverage, and two tagged releases make both the product entity and its agent integration easier to retrieve from GitHub.
dimensions.remainingGap: No authoritative external directory listing or post-change search observation yet demonstrates discovery beyond MaxVideoAI-owned GitHub and website surfaces.

dimensions.label: Human-facing GEO
dimensions.afterRationale: Five public intent owners plus self-contained GitHub answers now define the product, model-comparison decision, pricing boundary, Library continuity, and equal Claude/ChatGPT/Codex routes alongside current multimodal proof and crawler-readable source declarations.
dimensions.remainingGap: No earned citation or clean post-change observation window yet shows that an external answer engine selects these passages.

dimensions.label: Agent discovery and selection
dimensions.afterRationale: The reviewed 24-case discovery layer and 70-case selection corpus now cover named Claude and Codex discovery, negative routing, citations, safety, and recovery with deterministic policy results.
dimensions.remainingGap: Curated discovery is 100%, but the separately reviewed claude_host and codex_host evidence columns correctly remain null.

dimensions.label: Trust and evidence
dimensions.afterRationale: Fresh screenshot provenance, unique-byte and decode-integrity gates, paid-action safety boundaries, public support/security files, and checksum-backed v0.3.0 and v0.3.1 releases establish a reviewable trust chain without converting website proof into a host claim.
dimensions.remainingGap: There is still no archived real-host result packet, and the separate checked-in 0.3.2 candidate has not completed its own source-tag, checksum, and clean-install gate.

dimensions.label: Distribution and backlinks
dimensions.afterRationale: A focused public repository with two checksum-backed releases, owned-site acquisition paths, and ten evidence-gated distribution decisions supports the 40-point gain without inventing a directory acceptance or backlink.
dimensions.remainingGap: No authoritative external listing, contextual referring domain, or approved directory backlink has been verified.

dimensions.label: Measurement and iteration
dimensions.afterRationale: Fail-closed UTM maps, privacy-filtered browser projection, and clean cohort definitions establish implementation readiness without fabricating conversion performance.
dimensions.remainingGap: There is no privacy-reviewed server-side GitHub-to-MCP association, library_opened emitter, complete emitter coverage, or clean 14-day cohort.
